# RankRGV

RankRGV is a local SEO and digital marketing agency based in the Rio Grande Valley, Texas. We help small and medium businesses in McAllen, Edinburg, Mission, Harlingen, Brownsville, and surrounding RGV cities get found on Google — specifically in Google Maps, the local pack, and organic search.

## What We Do

- **Local SEO**: Google Business Profile optimization, local citations, content, and rank tracking to build sustained Google Maps and organic rankings
- **GBP Management**: Ongoing Google Business Profile maintenance — posts, review responses, photo management, and monthly optimization
- **Web Design**: Fast-loading, mobile-first websites built to rank and convert (99+ PageSpeed scores)
- **Google & Meta Ads**: Flat-fee paid ads management with no setup fees and no commissions on ad spend
- **Business Automation**: Missed call text-back, automated review requests, and lead follow-up systems

## Who We Serve

Small and medium businesses in the Rio Grande Valley (RGV), Texas — particularly home services, roofing, HVAC, auto body, real estate, legal, and healthcare verticals. We specialize in bilingual English/Spanish markets.
